extract_mpi_inf_3dhp_train: extract MPI-INF-3DHP training data with 2D/3D joints and openpose keypoints to npz format
extract_mpi_inf_3dhp_test: extract MPI-INF-3DHP test data with 2D/3D joints and visibility filters to npz format
read_calibration: read camera calibration parameters from MPI-INF-3DHP calibration file for specified video indices
train_data_with_smpl: process training data with optional SMPL fits for 3D mesh visualization and pose estimation
extract_video_frames: extract frames from MPI-INF-3DHP video files and save as individual JPEG images
